newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar extends losses by close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar extends losses by close.

text.p: London white sugar futures extended their losses by the close on Tuesday ahead of this week's December expiry.
Spot December finished down $3.90 at $303.80 per tonne, just 30 cents off its low. March ended $3.70 weaker at $303.00, also just slightly above its intra-day low.
Market sources said December could easily go below $300 before it goes off the board a the close of business on Friday.
In Paris, December was down $2.00 at $304.50 while March was up 40 cents at $303.00.
